# glinet_wireless_interface (Resource)

Manage one OpenWrt Wi-Fi access point. Keep a direct wired management path for changes. For adoption, omit `key_wo` and `key_version` to keep the current passphrase.

## Import existing configuration

Use an initialized project from [Check the router](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/elephant-evergreen/glinet/latest/docs#check-the-router). Add this import block with your resource address and the existing object’s ID.

```terraform
import {
  to = glinet_wireless_interface.private_2g
  id = "wifi2g"
}
```

1. Add the example’s resource block with the values already on the router.
2. Run `terraform plan -out=adopt.tfplan` and keep a plan that contains only the import. If it proposes changes, match the differing arguments to the router and save a new plan.
3. Apply the saved plan.

If you are unsure what values to use, [generate a draft from the existing object](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import/generating-configuration). Keep the import block, omit the resource block, and run `terraform plan -generate-config-out=generated.tf`. Review the draft before preparing the saved import plan.

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "glinet_wireless_interface" "private_2g" {
  section    = "wifi2g"
  ssid       = "Example"
  device     = "mt798611"
  network    = "lan"
  mode       = "ap"
  encryption = "psk2"
  isolate    = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `section` (String) UCI wifi-iface section name.
- `ssid` (String) SSID (1–32 UTF-8 bytes).

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `delete_behavior` (String) Destroy behavior. `forget` releases Terraform ownership and preserves the UCI section; `delete` removes a Terraform-created named section. Firmware-owned anonymous sections are always preserved.
- `device` (String) Radio device, such as `mt798611`.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable the AP.
- `encryption` (String) Encryption, such as `psk2`.
- `hidden` (Boolean) Hide the SSID.
- `ifname` (String) Optional radio interface name.
- `isolate` (Boolean) Client isolation.
- `key_version` (Number) Client-managed key generation. Increase it when rotating `key_wo`.
- `key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only WPA passphrase (8–63 printable ASCII). It is not stored in plan or state.
- `mode` (String) Wi-Fi mode, normally `ap`.
- `network` (String) Network interface this AP joins.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable import identifier.
- `uci_section` (String) Resolved UCI section name on the router.
